rust.assertion: After DATA 250, SIGKILL and store reopen preserve subject and body.
Reject raw DATA above the conservative capture allocation bound before building payload copies.
Projected fanout exceeding the local 64 MiB capture budget returns 552, persists no mail, and permits a later small transaction.
SIGTERM during admitted DATA completes with 250; reopening the capture store retains the accepted message.
